pairs.why: Both render the fruit about the same way, but B's higher three-quarter view shows more of the glass plate, which is closer to the near-top-down framing of the real card.
B is more saturated, wetter and glossier, with heavy dew and a crowded heap; A's calmer, softer finish and simpler layout match the real plate better.
The two are nearly identical in finish and colour; A's layout of oranges in front, grapes behind and no leaf is only marginally nearer the real arrangement.
A has the door on the right with rounded vents and a chunkier body, like the real locker; B's flatter, boxier body and left-hand door read less like it.
A's rounded, pillowy top, soft rounded vents and stubby legs match the real locker's chunky toy-like build, while B is a stiffer, sharper-edged box.
B is tall and thin with spindly legs and fine slotted vents, which reads like a real metal locker; A keeps the chunky, soft-edged proportions of the real card.
B has a closed beak with softer, calmer shading, nearer the real duck; A's open-mouth cartoon face and glossier, more saturated plastic push it toward toy polish.
A's closed beak and calmer, softer rendering match the real duck, while B's open grinning beak and shinier finish read more cartoonish and glossy.
